scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run generate:ai-docs && npm run build -w site
scripts.build:lib: npm run build -w glyptide && npm run build -w @glyptide/react
scripts.dev: npm run build:lib && npm run generate:ai-docs && npm run dev -w site
scripts.check:ai-docs: npm run generate:ai-docs && git diff --exit-code -- site/public/llms.txt site/public/llms-full.txt site/public/registry site/public/schemas site/public/docs site/public/skills || (echo 'AI docs out of date — run npm run generate:ai-docs' && exit 1)
